description_expanded:
This lovely 2-bedroom vacation rental is located in the newest condominium building at Alys Beach, The Whitby, overlooking the emerging Town Center. The Caliza Pool complex as well as the Gulf are a short walk away. The open-concept kitchen and family room provides ample dining and living space with access to a private balcony with beautiful views of the Amphitheatre. Both bedrooms offer king-size beds with private baths. Parking for this condominium is located in one designated space behind the building. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Whitby 203. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
